meta.name: email-automation-builder
meta.description: Build multi-sequence email automation flows with branching logic. Triggers on: "build email automation", "create email funnel", "email automation flow", "welcome series with branches", "conditional email sequence", "set up automation", "email workflow builder", "segmented email flow", "advanced email sequence", "nurture funnel", "cart abandonment sequence", "win-back email flow".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动构建多分支邮件自动化序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化管理邮件营销漏斗和用户培育流程
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate email marketing funnels and user nurturing flows

howto.what: 构建多步骤邮件自动化流程，支持分支逻辑（如打开/未打开、点击/未点击）。输出ASCII流程图、每封邮件的内容（主题、正文、行动号召）以及平台设置步骤。
howto.when: 当你说出“构建邮件自动化”、“创建邮件漏斗”、“条件邮件序列”等关键词，或要求将现有邮件序列升级为带分支的自动化时触发。

say.text: 创建一个欢迎邮件自动化流程，推广HeyGen。
say.note: 输出7步欢迎流程，带分支和设置步骤。

say.text: 把我之前建的那个邮件序列加上分支逻辑。
say.note: 升级现有线性序列为条件自动化。

howto.what_en: Builds multi-step email automation flows with branching logic (e.g., opened/not opened, clicked/not clicked). Outputs ASCII flow diagrams, email content (subject, body, CTA), and platform setup instructions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "build email automation", "create email funnel", "conditional email sequence", etc., or when you request upgrading an existing drip sequence to a branched automation.

say_en.text: Create a welcome email automation for HeyGen.
say_en.note: Generates a 7-step welcome flow with branches and setup.

say_en.text: Add branching logic to my previous drip sequence.
say_en.note: Upgrades the existing linear sequence to a conditional automation.
